description: This Kotlin file defines a calendar handler for an Android application, including data classes for calendar requests and events, an interface for calendar data source operations, an implementation using Android's CalendarContract, and a CalendarHandler class that manages calendar event retrieval and addition with JSON parsing and permission checks.

classes.name: CalendarEventsRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to fetch calendar events, specifying start and end times in milliseconds and a limit on the number of events.

classes.name: CalendarAddRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to add a new calendar event, including details like title, timing, location, notes, and calendar identification.

classes.name: CalendarEventRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event, including its identifier, title, ISO-formatted start and end times, all-day flag, location, and calendar title.

classes.name: CalendarDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for calendar data operations, such as permission checks, fetching events, and adding events.

classes.name: SystemCalendarDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of CalendarDataSource that interacts with Android's CalendarProvider using CalendarContract and ContentResolver.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has read permission for the calendar.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has write permission for the calendar.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Fetches calendar events within a specified time range and limit.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new calendar event based on the provided request.

methods.name: resolveCalendarId
methods.description: Resolves the calendar ID based on provided ID or title, or defaults to primary calendar.

methods.name: calendarExists
methods.description: Checks if a calendar with the specified ID exists.

methods.name: findCalendarByTitle
methods.description: Finds a calendar by its display name.

methods.name: findDefaultCalendarId
methods.description: Finds the default primary calendar ID.

methods.name: loadEventById
methods.description: Loads a specific calendar event by its ID.

methods.name: handleCalendarEvents
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON request to fetch calendar events with permission checks.

methods.name: handleCalendarAdd
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON request to add a calendar event with permission checks.

methods.name: parseEventsRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a CalendarEventsRequest object.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a CalendarAddRequest object.

methods.name: parseISO
methods.description: Parses ISO string into Instant object.

methods.name: eventJson
methods.description: Converts a CalendarEventRecord into a JSON object.
